notes: Three co-shaykhs («حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ... وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ وَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ») form one level; «(رحمه الله)» is a blessing, left out.
The Imam written after «عن» stays a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the Imam's words after «قال» are the saying. The text is cut off mid-saying in the packet.
